text: This report provides a status update on the Zoning By-law Amendment application for 2180-2210 Yonge Street, 15 Eglinton Avenue West, and 20 and 46 Berwick Avenue. Staff anticipate bringing a Final Report on the application to the Planning and Housing Committee in 2023.
The Planning and Housing Committee: 1. Received the report (June 16, 2022) from the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning for information.
